# Hosea Chapter 3 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 331r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**3:1** And-said YHWH to-me, "Go again od, love ehav a-woman ishah loved ahuv by-a-friend re'a and-an-adulteress mena'afet, as YHWH loves ahavat the-sons of-Yisra'el, and-they turn vehem ponim to other gods elohim acherim and-love ohavei raisin-cakes ashishshei anavim."

**3:2** And-I-bought-her va'ekkereha for-myself for-fifteen ba-chamishah asar pieces of silver kesef and-a-homer chomer of-barley se'orim and-a-lethekh lethekh of-barley.

**3:3** And-I-said to-her, "Many rabbim days yamim you-will-sit teshvi for-me; you-will-not play-the-harlot lo tizniy, and-you-will-not be lo tihyi for-a-man le-ish; and-also I will wait for-you."

**3:5** Afterwards achar the-sons of-Yisra'el will-return yashuvu and-seek u-viqqeshu YHWH their-God and-David their-king, and-they-will-come-trembling ufachadu to YHWH and-to his-goodness tuvo in-the-end be-acharit of-the-days ha-yamim.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Hosea 3 — "Hosea Redeems His Wife" — continues the book's distinctive blend of personal biography and national theology. The marriage metaphor that structures the entire book gives Hosea an emotional intensity unmatched in the prophetic corpus.

---

This chapter produced minor register disagreements resolved through SOPHIA's standard consensus process.
